faultCodes.display: Red LED flashes 3 times, then pauses
likelyCauses: Kinked or cracked pressure switch hose

faultCodes.display: Red LED flashes 4 times, then pauses

C3-1.instruction: Call for heat and check whether the inducer motor runs.

C3-2.instruction: Check the pressure switch hose for kinks, cracks, or water.

C3-3.instruction: Inducer does not run on a call for heat.

outcome.summary: Check inducer voltage; replace the inducer motor if it has power but won't run.
Clear or replace the pressure switch hose, then retest.
Inspect the vent and intake for blockage; if clear, test or replace the pressure switch.
Replace the filter and confirm the limit closes after cooling.
Check blower operation and duct restrictions.
